specs.title: [R-UI-5] after a successful create the table is re-fetched without a full page reload
[R-UI-6] Delete reveals "Confirm delete" in the same row; only one open at a time; nothing deleted until confirmed
[R-UI-12] an empty or whitespace-only destination shows the invalid_url alert; submitting causes no navigation and no non-GET/HEAD request
[R-UI-11] a full create -> stats -> delete -> error journey sends no browser request to /api/
[R-UI-7] heading, totals and the four tables match the API stats (default window)
[R-UI-7] a link with no clicks: zero totals and breakdown tables with a header row and no body rows
[R-UI-7][gray-box] totals are base-10 integers without separators
[R-UI-8] the 7/30/90 days links set ?days= and the matching one has aria-current="page"
[R-UI-8] a valid days without a link is honored (1 and 365) and no link is current
[R-UI-8] missing or invalid days behaves exactly like days=30, including aria-current on "30 days"
[R-UI-9] an unknown code responds 404 with the level-1 heading "Link not found"
[R-UI-9][R-DEL-1] a deleted link's page responds 404 "Link not found"
